#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local edge-case tests for the identity boundary processor."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {
        "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
        "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
    },
    "accounts": {
        "session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]},
        "solo": {"primary": "sip:desk@sales.test", "allow": []},
    },
    "gateways": {
        "edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}},
        "inside": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test", "sales.test"]}},
        "narrow": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"edge": ["sales.test"]}},
        "hostless": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test"]}},
    },
}

def H(**kw):
    h = kw.get("headers", [])
    out = []
    out.append("%s %s SIP/2.0" % (kw.get("method", "MESSAGE"), kw.get("uri", "sip:inbox@relay.test")))
    out.extend(h)
    body = kw.get("body", "hello")
    out.append("Content-Length: %d" % len(body))
    return "\r\n".join(out) + "\r\n\r\n" + body

def run(jobs):
    batch = dict(CTX)
    batch["jobs"] = jobs
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("exit %d %r" % (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[-2000:]))
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())["results"]

CASES = []
def case(name, raw, expect, gw="edge", ingress=None, trusted_out=True, headers=None):
    if ingress is None:
        ingress = {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}
    if headers is not None:
        raw = H(headers=headers)
    CASES.append((name, {"gateway": gw, "ingress": ingress, "trusted_out": trusted_out, "raw": raw}, expect))

def simple(extra=None, frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7", body="hello", **kw):
    hs = [frm, "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "Call-ID: c-1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]
    if extra: hs = extra + hs
    return H(headers=hs, body=body, **kw)

def rej(reason):
    return {"status": "reject", "reason": reason}

def acc(ident="sip:ember@studio.test", basis="local", private=False, wire=None, **kw):
    d = {"status": "accept", "identity": ident, "basis": basis, "private": private}
    if wire is None:
        body = kw.get("body", "hello")
        hs = ["From: <%s>%s" % (ANONU if private else ident, ";tag=q7" if not kw.get("notag") else ""),
              "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "Call-ID: c-1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]
        d["wire"] = H(headers=hs, body=body)
    else:
        d["wire"] = wire
    return d

ANONU = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"
BASE = simple()

# ---------------- framing ----------------
case("lf-only", BASE.replace("\r\n", "\n"), rej("syntax"))
case("cr-only", BASE.replace("\r\n", "\r"), rej("syntax"))
case("missing-blank", BASE[:-len("hello")] , rej("syntax"))
case("nonascii-header", simple().replace("Call-ID: c-1", "Call-ID: c-1\xc3\xa9"), rej("syntax"))
case("nonascii-body", simple(body="hell\xc3\xa9"), rej("syntax"))
case("del-body", simple(body="hell\x7f"), rej("syntax"))
case("ctrl-header", simple().replace("c-1", "c-\x01"), rej("syntax"))
case("tab-in-value-ok", simple(extra=["Content-Type: text/plain;\tcharset=utf-8"]).replace(
    "Content-Type: text/plain;\tcharset=utf-8", "Content-Type: text/plain;\tcharset=utf-8"), None)
case("body-crlf-ok", simple(body="a\r\nb\r\n\r\nc: d\r\nFrom: <sip:zz@zz.test>"), None)
case("empty-body", simple(body=""), None)
case("empty-text", "", rej("syntax"))

# ---------------- request line ----------------
case("lowercase-method", simple().replace("MESSAGE", "message", 1), rej("syntax"))
case("invite", simple(method="INVITE").replace("CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9 INVITE"), None)
case("double-space-rl", "MESSAGE  sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n" + BASE.split("\r\n", 1)[1], rej("syntax"))
case("tel-request-uri", simple(uri="tel:+12025550121"), rej("syntax"))
case("sips-request-uri", simple(uri="sips:inbox@relay.test"), rej("syntax"))
case("bad-version", simple().replace("SIP/2.0", "SIP/2.1"), rej("syntax"))
case("trailing-space-rl", simple().replace("SIP/2.0\r\n", "SIP/2.0 \r\n"), rej("syntax"))

# ---------------- header limits / structure ----------------
many = ["X-Pad-%d: v" % i for i in range(200)]
case("many-unknown-headers", simple(extra=many), rej("syntax"))   # 204 > 128 fields
few = ["X-Pad-%d: v" % i for i in range(100)]
case("ok-unknown-headers", simple(extra=few), None)
case("orphan-continuation", "\tX: y\r\n" + BASE, rej("syntax"))
case("dup-from-compact", simple().replace("To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nf: <sip:ember@studio.test>"), rej("syntax"))
case("dup-cl-equal", simple().replace("Content-Length: 5", "Content-Length: 5\r\nl: 5"), rej("syntax"))
case("dup-ctype", simple(extra=["Content-Type: text/plain", "Content-Type: text/plain"]), rej("syntax"))
case("missing-to", H(headers=["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "Call-ID: c-1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], body="hello"), rej("syntax"))
case("bad-header-name", simple().replace("Call-ID: c-1", "Call ID: c-1"), rej("syntax"))
case("empty-header-name", simple().replace("Call-ID: c-1", ": c-1"), rej("syntax"))
case("space-before-colon", simple().replace("Call-ID: c-1", "Call-ID : c-1"), None)
case("compact-all", H(headers=["f: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7", "t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                               "i: c-1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "c: text/plain"], body="hello"), None)
case("unfold", "MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@\r\n studio.test>;tag=q7\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c-1\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\n\r\nhello", rej("syntax"))
case("unfold-ok", "MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>;\r\n tag=q7\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c-1\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\n\r\nhello", None)

# ---------------- field values ----------------
case("callid-bad-char", simple().replace("c-1", "c 1"), rej("syntax"))
case("callid-too-long", simple().replace("c-1", "c" * 129), rej("syntax"))
case("callid-128", simple().replace("c-1", "c" * 128), None)
case("cseq-zero", simple().replace("CSeq: 9", "CSeq: 0"), rej("syntax"))
case("cseq-big", simple().replace("CSeq: 9", "CSeq: 2147483648"), rej("syntax"))
case("cseq-max", simple().replace("CSeq: 9", "CSeq: 2147483647"), None)
case("cseq-method-mismatch", simple().replace("CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9 INVITE"), rej("syntax"))
case("cseq-nospace", simple().replace("CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9MESSAGE"), rej("syntax"))
case("cseq-tabs", simple().replace("CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9\tMESSAGE"), None)
case("cl-nonnum", simple().replace("Content-Length: 5", "Content-Length: abc"), rej("syntax"))
case("cl-mismatch", simple(body="hi"), rej("syntax"))
case("cl-zeros", simple().replace("Content-Length: 5", "Content-Length: 005"), None)
case("privacy-both", simple(extra=["Privacy: both"]), rej("syntax"))
case("privacy-none", simple(extra=["Privacy: none"]), None)
case("privacy-id-caps", simple(extra=["Privacy: ID"]), None)
case("ctype-empty", simple(extra=["Content-Type: "]), rej("syntax"))
case("ctype-tab", simple(extra=["Content-Type: text/plain\t;charset=utf-8"]), None)
